text:
**Spatial Reasoning for 3D Agents**
**Date:** 2026-08-10
**Lens:** Executable spatial reasoning — declare coordinate frames and units, use transforms explicitly, then validate with measurements, ray casts, or collision checks.

---

## 1. Coordinate Frames & Transforms

| Technique | Core Idea | Implementation | Production Notes |
|-----------|-----------|----------------|------------------|
| **Column-major 4×4 Matrices** | Model–view–projection as a single matrix; composition = matrix multiplication. | Unity `Matrix4x4`, Unreal `FMatrix`, GLM `glm::mat4` | Deterministic, GPU-compatible, easy to serialize. Choose left-handed (Unity) or right-handed (Unreal) consistently. |
| **Quaternions** | Axis-angle `q = (x, y, z, w)` without gimbal lock. | Unity `Quaternion`, GLM `glm::quat`, DirectX `XMVECTORF3` | Smooth interpolation (`Slerp`, `NLerp`); store as `float4` for SIMD. |
| **Euler ↔ Quaternion** | `ToQuaternion` via half-angle; `ToEuler` via `atan2` of quaternion components. | `glm::quat_cast`, Unity `Quaternion.Euler` | Use only for UI/asset import; **never** store as primary rotation. |
| **Transform Hierarchy** | Local → world: `M = T_parent * M_local`. Inverse: `M_local = M_parent⁻¹ * M_world`. | Unity `Transform`, Unreal `USceneComponent` | Cache `parent->world` and use for child updates; use a bitfield dirty flag rather than timestamps. |
| **SIMD Structs** | Pack `float3`/`float4` into `__m128` (SSE) or `float32x4_t` (NEON). | DirectX `XMVECTOR`, GLM `packed_vec3`, Unity `Vector3` | Enables batch matrix–vector multiplies; engines expose auto-vectorized `Mathf`/`FMath` APIs. |

## 2. Vector & Matrix Primitives

| Primitive | Implementation | Libraries | Why It’s Robust |
|-----------|----------------|-----------|-----------------|
| **Cross Product** | `c = a × b` (perpendicular; zero if parallel). | `glm::cross`, Unity `Vector3.Cross`, `FVector::CrossProduct` | Safe to call; guard with length test for parallel inputs. |
| **Dot & Angle** | `dot = a·b`; `angle = acos(clamp(dot, -1, 1))`. | Same as above | Clamp avoids NaN for nearly-unit vectors; normalize after accumulating forces. |
| **Reflection / Refraction** | `r = v – 2(v·n)n`; Snell’s law `eta`. | `glm::reflect`, `glm::refract` | Analytical (no iteration); matches GPU GLSL code. |
| **Orthogonal Basis (Gram–Schmidt)** | `v1 = normalize(v1 - dot(v1,v0)*v0)`. | Custom | Cheaper than full QR; used for camera “look-at” or local axes. |
| **4×4 × 4×4 Multiply** | Cache 16 temp values; unroll loops if no SIMD mat class. | GLM `operator*`, DirectX `XMMatrixMultiply` | Matches GPU column-major order; uploads without transpose. |

## 3. Ray Casting & Intersection

| Method | Core Idea | Typical API | Speed Tier | When to Use |
|--------|-----------|-------------|------------|-------------|
| **Ray–AABB** | Slab method: compute per-axis tenter/texit, find overlap interval. | Unity `Bounds.Raycast`, `glm::intersectRayAABB` | O(1) | Broad phase for static worlds or continued gradually increased” and have a PDF (standard not analog) overview of mental state and acute problems (eg: bacteria from his poorly equipped fishing).
